feeds.title: Santa Barbara Sheriff
feeds.description: The Santa Barbara County Sheriff's Office is led by Bill Brown, the elected Santa Barbara County Sheriff-Coroner. The men and women of the Santa Barbara County Sheriff's Office are proud to protect the people of this beautiful county. Our dedicated team of professionals upholds our five core values, integrity, caring, courage, fairness, and service, in all that we do.

feeds.title: Monmouth County Sheriff's Office
feeds.description: It is a pleasure to welcome you to the Monmouth County Sheriffs Office website. This site provides up-to-date information and 24/7 access for residents within our community. Whether you seek specific information or have just stopped by to browse, we invite you to explore our site and learn more about our offices numerous responsibilities and duties.

feeds.title: Lexington County Sheriff's Department
feeds.description: The Lexington County Sheriffs Department is a full-service, internationally accredited law enforcement agency. Our mission is to work as a professional law enforcement team to build relationships with those we are sworn to serve.

feeds.title: Charlotte County Sheriff's Office
feeds.description: It is our mission that the Charlotte County Sheriff's Office serves the citizens and visitors of Charlotte County by providing professional law enforcement, detention, and court security. For more information about the Charlotte County Sheriffs Office, please follow our blog.

feeds.title: Lafourche Parish Sheriff's Office
feeds.description: Under the leadership of Sheriff Craig Webre, we are Nationally Accredited through the Commission on Accreditation for Law Enforcement Agencies and the American Correctional Association. We work hard to exceed standards of excellence in law enforcement to provide you with the best protection and service offered in the world.

feeds.title: Sioux County Sheriff
feeds.description: Official Sioux County, Iowa Sheriff's Website. We believe our primary responsibility is to help maintain the safety and well-being of the people in Sioux County. Our officers will make every attempt to enforce all laws equally, for all individuals, using discretion, honesty, and common sense in the performance of their duties.

feeds.title: NY Sheriffs Association
feeds.description: The New York State Sheriff's Association is a not-for-profit corporation formed in 1934 to assist Sheriff's in the delivery of services to the public.

feeds.title: St. Bernard Sheriff's Office
feeds.description: St. Bernard Sheriff's Office aims at Keeping St. Bernard Safe. Follow for the latest news and updates.

feeds.title: Essex County Sheriff's Office
feeds.description: Sheriff Armando B. Fontoura is responsible for operating the largest and most active Sheriffs Department in New Jersey. The agency serves the people of Essex County and the states largest Superior Court vicinage.

feeds.title: Maverick County Sheriff
feeds.description: The Maverick County Sheriff's Office (MCSO) goal is to provide professional, high quality, and effective police, correctional, and court security services in partnership with their community.

feeds.title: Mobile County Sheriff's Office
feeds.description: The Mobile County Sheriffs Office is the second largest in the state, with a staff of over 600 serving more than 400,000 citizens across an area of some 1,200 square miles. Follow for more updates.

feeds.title: Prince George's County Office of the Sheriff
feeds.description: Follow for Prince Georges County Sheriff's Office latest news and events.

feeds.title: St. Mary's County Sheriff's Office
feeds.description: Follow St. Marys County Sheriff's Office blog for Official News and Information from the Sheriff's department.

feeds.title: Davis County Sheriff's Office
feeds.description: Our fundamental duty is to serve the community. We are actively engaged in improving the quality of life for everyone in Davis County. Follow us for latest Media Advisories, Alerts, and Releases.

feeds.title: Callaway County Sheriff's Ofice
feeds.description: The Callaway County Sheriff's Office is primarily responsible for maintaining the Callaway County Jail, serving all civil process and providing law enforcement services for unincorporated Callaway County. Follow for more information.
